findings.title: Single-node aws_elasticache_cluster cannot cross-engine upgrade to Valkey
findings.description: aws_elasticache_cluster with engine redis and no replication_group_id. A single-node cluster can't be upgraded in place to Valkey. Proposed manual change: refactor into an aws_elasticache_replication_group (separate change, plan for replacement or migration of data), then rerun the analysis. Target C (stay on Redis OSS 7.1) needs no change.

findings.title: In-transit encryption is not set; Valkey target requires it
findings.description: transit_encryption_enabled is not set on the resource. A Valkey replication group requires in-transit encryption, and turning on TLS changes how every client connects. Don't set it automatically. The customer decides to enable TLS (TransitEncryptionMode preferred first, then required) as part of the replication-group refactor, or chooses Redis OSS 7.1 (target C).

findings.title: Live data, AWS Health and Trusted Advisor not used
findings.description: live_access=off was set in the plan context. No live caches, parameter groups, Health events or Trusted Advisor checks were read. Status comes from AWS documentation and the repository. Drift was not checked. Unmanaged live caches, if any, are not reported.

findings.title: Module has no callers in this repository; effective version assumed from default
findings.description: aws/redis is a reusable module with no module block or tfvars in this repository that sets redis_version, instance_type or num_cache_nodes. Defaults are used (7.1, cache.t2.micro, 1 node). If a caller elsewhere sets redis_version to 4.x, 5.x or 6.x, that deployment would be in or near Extended Support (4/5: paying since 2026-02-01; 6: charges start 2027-02-01). Confirm the deployed values with the module callers.

findings.title: No application changes detected
findings.description: No Redis client libraries, Lua scripts, redis_version checks, hard-coded node IPs, docker-compose or Helm Redis images were found. The repository is infrastructure only. The general items still apply: node IPs change during an upgrade (use the endpoint DNS name), expect a short failover so clients should retry with backoff, detect Valkey with server_name / valkey_version rather than redis_version, and merge the code change before running the upgrade.
